heading: Quaternion vs Euler Rotation
subtitle: Watch how a plane and its normal vector are reoriented in 3D space, using two different rotation representations.
gimbal_hint: Tip: set Pitch close to 90° and try changing Roll and Yaw — notice how the Euler panel loses a degree of freedom (gimbal lock), while the quaternion panel doesn't.
footer_note: Built with Three.js. Rotations are computed live in your browser.
